svg.title: Тяга Т-грифа с упором грудью — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Chest-supported T-bar row machine. Three-quarter side view that clearly shows the athlete leaning chest-down on an angled padded chest rest, standing with both feet on the raised machine footplate, facing the weighted end of the machine. Show a long single floor-pivoted T-bar lever underneath the body with a transverse handle crosspiece and circular weight plates on the one free end. Both hands hold the crosspiece's two handles. Left arms down with weight lowered. Right elbows pulled up/back, weighted lever visibly lifted, chest continuously on support pad and both feet planted. No cable, no handheld dumbbells, no two-ended free barbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
